# Alpha release checklist

## Repository
- [ ] Private repository created
- [ ] Files uploaded at repository root
- [ ] `app/js/config.js` not committed
- [ ] No accidental `CNAME`
- [ ] GitHub Actions validation passes

## Functional
- [ ] First-time flow completes
- [ ] Retirement Brief renders
- [ ] Recommendations render
- [ ] Scenario comparison updates

## Supabase

- [ ] Password recovery works

## Quality

- [ ] iPad portrait and landscape
- [ ] Mobile width
- [ ] Keyboard navigation
- [ ] Reduced motion
- [ ] No unexpected console errors
- [ ] Calculation regression comparison completed
